brief.scope: Work order: the uncited-correction gate. The requirements are the ten numbered Contract items of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md, tracked in this snapshot at the ref; read it and .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-discipline.md WHOLE from the snapshot tree. Nothing else is a requirement. Refuse at mint any write job that answers reviewer findings unless every finding it answers is named by key, disposed in the findings ledger, and the disposition cites the numbered contract item it violates; the ladder stops before its fix stages instead of correcting. No override. Boundaries as listed there; do not widen them.

findings.claim: contract item 3 of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md and contract item 4 of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md: `_scope_path` does not identify the work-order Contract file, so a satisfying citation is refused and the needed command does not satisfy. This snapshot has three `.dev/ladder-inputs/scope-*.md` files (`scope-discipline.md`, `scope-gate-20260910.md`, `scope-gate-20260910.scope.md`). An item-1 correction (write job, `--follows` a review record, `--answers` a key) whose evidence is `contract item 3 of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md: found-text missing` is refused `disposed fixed without a contract citation (citation does not name the correction scope file)` when no `--input` is given. Needed is `python3 ops/conductor/tools/findings.py disposition '<key>' fixed 'contract item 1 of .dev/ladder-inputs/<scope path>: correction'`; the citation grammar captures path `.dev/ladder-inputs/<scope>`. Running that printed command exits 0; the next check repeats the same refusal. With `--input` of only `scope-gate-20260910.scope.md` (the 1024-byte cap file, no `N. ` line), needed cites item 1 of that file; running it still refuses (`contract item 1 is absent from the cited scope file`). With `--input` of `scope-discipline.md` then the Contract file, needed asks to cite the discipline clause, not the Contract. Item 1 defines a correction from `--follows` / `out/` input alone. The accept path with `--input` of `scope-gate-20260910.md` does pass. Frozen tests hide this by planting a single `scope-*.md`.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; print(sorted(p.name for p in Path('.dev/ladder-inputs').glob('scope-*.md')))"  # three names at e0dee24. Isolate HOME; copy correction.py and findings.py into a temp repo that contains those three scope files and a planted adversarial-review record; import; disposition KEY fixed 'contract item 3 of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md: found-text missing'; python3 ops/conductor/tools/correction.py check --job implement --role write --at 2099-01-01T00:00:00Z --records <records> --jobs-root <jobs> --root <repo> --follows <id> --answers <id>#1  # exit 2, needed contains '<scope path>'. shlex-split and run that needed command (exit 0); repeat check (still exit 2). Repeat check with --input of scope-gate-20260910.scope.md only; run its needed command; repeat check (exit 2, item 1 absent). Repeat with --input of scope-discipline.md first (needed cites that file). Repeat with --input of scope-gate-20260910.md (exit 0).

findings.claim: contract item 4 of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md and contract item 9 of .dev/ladder-inputs/scope-gate-20260910.md: `cited` and the gate do not resolve the same scope file, so the ledger half of item 9 can disagree with mint. The same holding disposition is `cited` exit 0 when the source record's `brief.inputs` has basename `scope-gate-20260910.md`, and `uncited: the finding record names no available scope file` when that record has no `scope-*` brief input (the unique `scope-*.md` fallback fails on this tree). `correction.py check` without that file as `--input` still refuses the key. First `scope-*` basename wins, so a brief that names `scope-discipline.md` makes a Contract citation uncited. Item 9's driver read would therefore stop or continue independently of whether the mint gate would accept.
findings.reproduce: Same isolated plant as the p1 finding, with findings.py staged at <repo>/ops/conductor/tools/findings.py so ROOT is the temp repo. Record has no brief: python3 ops/conductor/tools/findings.py cited <id>#1  # exit 1, uncited: the finding record names no available scope file. Write brief.inputs path basename scope-gate-20260910.md; cited exits 0. Write brief.inputs basename scope-discipline.md; cited exits 1, citation does not name the correction scope file. Run correction.py check on the same key with no --input: still exit 2 uncited.
